en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hilly, wooded landscape with a winding road in the Mecsek mountains. In the foreground there is a tall street lamp, a railing along the road, and a vintage bus parked at a viewpoint or terrace. The reverse side contains printed Hungarian text indicating the view is from the terrace of the Mecsek SZOT holiday hotel in Pécs, handwritten Hungarian message, address lines, a Magyar Posta postage stamp and a circular postmark.
